result.instructions: Tools for Unleashed Software, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Unleashed Software data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run unleashed_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run unleashed_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run unleashed_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. unleashed_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: unleashed_get_company
tools.title: Get the company
tools.description: Fetch the Unleashed company these credentials belong to — name, base currency and default tax rate. A cheap way to confirm the API id, key and signature are right. Unleashed: GET /Companies.

tools.name: unleashed_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products, optionally searched by code/description or filtered by code prefix, group, brand, barcode or modification date. Unleashed: GET /Products/{page}.

product.description: Search text matched against product code or description.

productCode.description: Only products whose code starts with this.

productDescription.description: Only products whose description starts with this.

productGroup.description: Only products in this product group (subgroups excluded).

ProductBarcode.description: Only the product with this barcode.

brief.description: Return a condensed summary per product.

modifiedSince.description: Only records created or modified since this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

pageSize.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Unleashed default is 200.

tools.name: unleashed_get_product
tools.title: Get one product
tools.description: Fetch a single product by Guid — prices, units, stock alert levels, group, brand, supplier. Unleashed: GET /Products/{productGuid}.

tools.name: unleashed_list_stock_on_hand
tools.title: List stock on hand
tools.description: List stock on hand per product — QtyOnHand, AllocatedQty, AvailableQty, OnPurchase, AvgCost — optionally for one warehouse or as at a past date. Unleashed: GET /StockOnHand/{page}.

warehouseCode.description: Only stock in this warehouse code.

warehouseName.description: Only stock in this warehouse name.

asAtDate.description: Stock on hand as at this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

isAssembled.description: Include quantity that can be assembled via auto-assembly BOMs in AvailableQty.

modifiedSince.description: Only records created or modified since this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

pageSize.description: Records per page, 1-1000. Unleashed default is 200.

tools.name: unleashed_get_product_stock
tools.title: Get a product's stock
tools.description: Stock on hand for one product — totals, or broken down per warehouse with allWarehouses=true. The direct answer to 'how many do we have and where?'. Unleashed: GET /StockOnHand/{productGuid}[/AllWarehouses].

allWarehouses.description: Break the stock down per warehouse.

asAtDate.description: Stock on hand as at this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: unleashed_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a new customer. CustomerCode must be unique and cannot be changed later. Unleashed: POST /Customers.

customerCode.description: Unique customer code (cannot be changed after creation).

currencyCode.description: Currency code, e.g. NZD. Defaults to the base currency.

paymentTerm.description: Payment term name as configured in Unleashed.

taxable.description: Whether sales to this customer are taxable.

tools.name: unleashed_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Create a new product. ProductCode must be unique. Unleashed: POST /Products.

tools.name: unleashed_create_sales_order
tools.title: Create a parked sales order
tools.description: Create a DRAFT sales order with status Parked (reserves no stock, posts nothing to accounting — a person places or completes it in Unleashed). Line totals, line tax, SubTotal, TaxTotal and Total are computed for you to satisfy Unleashed's validation (SubTotal = sum of line totals, TaxTotal = sum of line taxes, Total = SubTotal + TaxTotal). Unleashed: POST /SalesOrders.

warehouseCode.description: The warehouse code to sell from.

exchangeRate.description: Exchange rate to the base currency. Default 1.

taxRate.description: Tax rate as a fraction, e.g. 0.15 for 15%.

taxCode.description: Tax code as configured in Unleashed, e.g. GST.

orderNumber.description: Order number; generated by Unleashed if omitted.
